name: Demon's Curse
source:
The Goddess of Light has blessed you, and in return you must slay the Demon King. Gather together an adventuring party from the local tavern and raid the undead's dungeon!

[from [url=https://jamkats.itch.io/demons-curse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
光明女神祝福了你，作为回报，你必须杀死魔王。从当地酒馆召集一支冒险队伍，突袭不死族的地牢！

[来自[url=https://jamkats.itch.io/demons-curse]itch.io[/url]]
